text: There is in our hearts an indignation against wrong that is righteous and benevolent; and he who is destitute of it is defective in the balance of his affections and in his moral character.
author: John Adams
reference: Familiar Letters of John Adams and His Wife Abigail Adams
locator: Letter 196, John Adams to Abigail Adams, Philadelphia, Tuesday, 19 August, 1777
